no_adcom_quote.quote: An advisory committee meeting was not convened for this BLA, as golimumab represents the fifth TNF inhibitor in class and no unique or controversial issues were identified from the data in this submission.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for BLA125289 (SIMPONI/golimumab). The review documents uniformly state that an AC meeting was deemed unnecessary because golimumab is the fifth anti-TNF-alpha product in a well-characterized class, with no unique or controversial safety or efficacy issues identified in the submission. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
